    • Field Detail

      • PLAYER_OPTIONS

        public static final java.lang.String[] PLAYER_OPTIONS
        PLAYER_OPTIONS holds the possible options for the user to choose as local player.

      • gameAvailable

        protected boolean gameAvailable
        gameAvailable is used to track whether a NEWGAME protocol has been sent to the client. This way the lobby loop knows when to close.

      • inQueue

        protected boolean inQueue
        inQueue tracks whether the client is in a queue, since the server does not send a reply to QUEUE.

      • lobbyThread

        protected java.lang.Thread lobbyThread
        The lobby thread. Used to join the lobbyThread with the main Thread handling the protocols while in a game.

      • setConnection

        public boolean setConnection​(java.lang.String[] host)
        Connects the client to the server and initializes sock, in, and out.
        Parameters:
        host - : 2 dimensional String array, with host[0] being the host address of the host in numerical form and host[1] being the port of the host through which to communicate.
        Returns:
        true, if successful, else false.
        Requires
        host != null.
        Ensures
        sock != null, in != null, out != null if successful.

      • setClientPlayer

        public boolean setClientPlayer​(java.lang.String playerType)
        Sets the type of CollectoClientPlayer to be used on this client, using playerType.

        Returns:
        true if successful and playerType != null, else false.
        Ensures
        localPlayer != null.

      • hello

        public void hello​(java.lang.String clientDescription)
           throws java.io.IOException,
                  InvalidResponseException
        Start initialization client-server connection with the HELLO protocol.
        Parameters:
        clientDescription - : the client description.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        InvalidResponseException - Signals that a the server has sent this client a message which is not part of the known protocols.
        Requires
        out != nul, clientDescription != null.

      • login

        public boolean login​(java.lang.String loginName)
              throws java.io.IOException,
                     InvalidResponseException
        Complete initialization client-server connection with the LOGIN protocol.
        Parameters:
        loginName - the user name with which to log on to the server.
        Returns:
        true if successful and loginName is not an existing name on the server.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        InvalidResponseException - Signals that a the server has sent this client a message which is not part of the known protocols.
        Requires
        out != null, loginName != null.

      • receiveList

        public void receiveList​(java.lang.String[] list)
                 throws java.io.IOException
        Implements the LIST protocol and should be called when LIST is received from the server. Reads the values of the list and prints them in human readable form
        Parameters:
        list - : the full message from the server containing the LIST message and the names of all connected clients.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        Requires
        out != null, list != null, list.length > 1.

        public void sendList()

        Implements the LIST protocol and sends a request to the server to send back a list of connected clients.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        Requires
        out != null.

      • receiveMove

        public void receiveMove​(int[] move)
                 throws java.io.IOException
        Implements the MOVE protocol and is called when the server has sent a MOVE message to make a move on the local game. Will call sendMove() if it's the local player's turn.
        Parameters:
        move - : the move to be made on the board as an integer array.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        Requires
        game != null, game.board != null.
        Ensures
        localPlayerTurn = !localPlayerTurn.

      • sendMove

        public void sendMove()
              throws java.io.IOException
        Implements the MOVE protocol and sends a message to the server containing the move to be played by the local player. This move is returned from calling getMove() from the localPlayer
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        Requires
        lobbyThread != null, out != null, localPlayer != null, game != null, game.board != null.

      • newGame

        public void newGame​(java.lang.String[] gridPlayers)
             throws java.io.IOException
        Implements the NEWGAME protocol and is called when NEWGAME is received. The parameters of the NEWGAME protocol, which contains the layout of the board, are passed through the parameter and used to initialize the local game
        Parameters:
        gridPlayers - : full message from the server containing the MOVE protocol, the board state, and the players in their playing order
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that the connection has closed.
        Requires
        gridPlayers != null, gridPlayer.length == 52
        Ensures
        game != null, game.board != null, gameAvailable = true, inQueue = false, localIsFirstPlayer = firstPlater.equals(loginName).

      • gameOver

        public void gameOver​(java.lang.String[] condition)
        Implements the GAMEOVER protocol and is called when GAMEOVER is received. Will cleanup the local game and start a new lobby TUI.
        Parameters:
        condition - : the full message from the server containing the GAMEOVER protocol, the win condition and possibly the winner's user name.
        Requires
        out != null, condition.length > 1.
        Ensures
        game = null, game.board = null, gameAvailable = false.
